categories.main_business_segments: Longshine Technology Group focuses on three main business segments: Energy Digitalization, Internet TV, and Energy Internet. Energy Digitalization provides software solutions and intelligent services for power and energy sectors, including marketing, data platforms, and AI applications. Internet TV segment offers platform operation, technical support, and smart terminal products for home internet TV services. Energy Internet segment operates platforms for life payment, aggregated charging for new energy vehicles, virtual power plants, and power market transactions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing, AI, big data, IoT, and digital twin technologies to develop its software and platform services. It employs a 'cloud + AI' architecture for energy digitalization and uses AI-driven models for load forecasting, intelligent customer service, and power market trading. Manufacturing of smart terminals is outsourced via contract manufacturing, with in-house R&D for design and development. The company also develops AI large models and low-code platforms to enhance operational efficiency and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Grid, energy groups, telecom operators, and new energy vehicle manufacturers. The company serves the power energy industry, public utilities, internet TV operators, and new energy vehicle charging service providers. Its markets cover provincial power companies, industrial and commercial users, residential consumers, and emerging sectors like virtual power plants and microgrids.
categories.geographic_coverage: Longshine operates primarily across China, with business presence in over 25 provinces. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Singapore and is expanding into Southeast Asian markets such as Indonesia and the Philippines through partnerships. The company’s energy internet platforms and services cover nationwide utility customers and new energy vehicle users.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy and digital service supply chain. It provides software solutions, platform services, and intelligent operation for power generation, distribution, and consumption. It also acts as a service aggregator and operator in the energy internet ecosystem, connecting end users, distributed energy resources, and market platforms. In smart terminals, it is involved in design and sales but outsources manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Longshine’s strategic focus is on dual-wheel development of energy digitalization and energy internet, driven by AI technology integration. It prioritizes R&D in AI large models, intelligent load forecasting, AI-powered power trading agents, and platform-based energy management. The company invests over 10% of revenue in R&D, emphasizing cloud, AI, big data, IoT, and low-code development. It aims to transform from project-driven software services to AI-driven platform energy operations and expand overseas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through software service contracts, platform operation fees, and sales of smart terminals. The company earns income from customized software development, maintenance services, platform transaction commissions, and charging service fees for new energy vehicles. It also receives government subsidies and investment income. Revenue recognition follows contract progress for software and service delivery milestones for platform operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longshine is positioned as a leading technology enterprise in China’s power energy digitalization and energy internet sectors. It competes with other domestic IT service providers and energy technology firms serving major grid companies and new energy markets. Its strong partnerships with State Grid, Southern Grid, and Ant Group, along with extensive AI capabilities, provide competitive advantages. The company holds significant market share in power marketing software and aggregated charging platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Longshine reported revenue of approximately RMB 4.48 billion, a slight decline of 5.24% year-over-year due to divestment of non-core businesses. Net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 250 million, impacted by one-time impairment and restructuring costs of RMB 488 million. Energy digitalization revenue was RMB 2.15 billion, down 7.51%, while energy internet revenue grew 17.63% to RMB 1.8 billion. The company maintains strong cash flow and total assets near RMB 9.8 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longshine emphasizes AI-driven intelligent energy solutions that integrate digitalization and internet platforms to provide convenient, economical, and green electricity services. Its unique value lies in deep industry experience, extensive platform data, and strong ecosystem partnerships, including with Ant Group. The company differentiates through comprehensive AI applications in load forecasting, power trading, virtual power plants, and aggregated charging, enabling efficient resource matching and market participation for diverse energy users.
